text:
PagerBot: PD alert fired for prometheus_scrape_errors (SEV2) — 74 failing targets across prometheus-scrape-proxy and node-exporter. PagerID: PD-48291. Escalation window 2m. @alexb you're primary oncall. https://pd.company/PD-48291

Alex B: acked — I'm on it. first pass: are failures global or region-scoped?

PD-Bot: Ack recorded by Alex B at 1769876550. Auto-escalation scheduled if no update in 3m.

Alex B: quick check: grafana shows sudden drop in scrape_success for prod-eu and prod-apac. prod-us looks OK. pulling exporter logs now.

Alex B: ```
kubectl -n monitoring logs prometheus-scrape-proxy-2 
[WARN] upstream timeout connecting to exporter node-exporter-7: dial tcp 10.48.3.19:9100: connect: connection timed out
[ERR] scrape loop aborted: context deadline exceeded
stack: net/http: request canceled (Client.Timeout exceeded)
```

Priya S: oncall lead here — I'm taking eu cluster. Samir take apac please. Alex, any sign of network egress issues or SG changes?

Alex B: nothing in the change log. k8s node egress metrics look normal but I see an unusual number of SYN resets from the scrape-proxy pod to the exporter IP range. suspicious.

Samir K: ack. restarting node-exporter daemonset on prod-apac to see if that clears flaps.

Customer Ops: heads up — dashboards in eu-west-1 showing missing host metrics for ~6 customers. Some are getting alert spam. We're drafting a status update.

Priya S: I'll do a rolling restart of prometheus-scrape-proxy in prod-eu with 30s pause between pods. Alex, can you flip the scrape timeout to 5s -> 3s as temporary mitigation in the scrape-proxy config?

Alex B: making a short-lived scrape patch now. command: `kubectl -n monitoring patch configmap prometheus-scrape-config -p '...timeout: 3s...'` applying to prod-eu only.

PagerBot: Config change applied to prod-eu scrape-proxy. New timeout 3s.

Samir K: node-exporter restart complete in prod-apac. I see pod ready count back to 3/3. Testing scrapes...

Alex B: after timeout tweak + proxy restarts, scrape success rate for prod-eu improved from 38% -> 92% over 1 minute. Reduced pager volume.

PD-Bot: PD incident updated by Alex B — mitigation in place, customer impact confirmed (partial dashboards missing). Escalation cancelled.

Customer Ops: status update posted to customers affected with ETA for full recovery ~15m. link: https://status.company/incidents/48291

eng-sre-rotation: FYI — we should consider tuning the scrape target health threshold. Current rule fires after 3 consecutive failures; maybe dampen to avoid chattiness.

Priya S: agree. Action items: (1) postmortem root-cause and network team correlation, (2) add exporter liveness guard with backoff + circuit breaker, (3) adjust alerting sensitivity for scrape flaps, (4) ensure customer ops templated updates exist. I'll file tasks.

Alex B: I'll queue a backfill job for the ~10k missing datapoints for affected targets. starting backfill now; ETA 40m.

Samir K: follow-up: opened a quick RT ticket to infra to review host-level firewall/ebpf rules for the exporter IP range.

PagerBot: PD-48291 resolved by Alex B at 1769877310 — condition recovered and mitigation applied.

Alex B: closing thread — metrics recovered in prod-eu and prod-apac, backfill in progress, customer notifications sent. Will attach logs and timeline to follow-up postmortem. :white_check_mark:

PD-Bot: PagerDuty incident PD-48291 marked RESOLVED (closed by Alex B).

Customer Ops: confirmed customers acknowledged the update, will reopen if issues reappear.

Priya S: nice work team. postmortem owner: Alex B. estimated write-up by EOD tomorrow.

eng-sre-rotation: handing off rotation to next oncall at 1769877360 — @Samir K takes remainder.

Alex B: thanks — marking runbook checklist complete.``
